Severe Weather and Incidents Mark Labor Day Weekend in US

Millions of people across the United States faced severe weather threats during the Labor Day weekend. In Chicago, two people were killed and three others injured in shootings, according to the Chicago Police Department. Meanwhile, thousands gathered for festivities and travel, with authorities advising travelers to be patient. Coastal areas like Ocean City, New Jersey, saw large crowds on beaches and boardwalks.
